data.name: Supreetha
data.gender_notes: Supreetha is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Supreetha means 'Graceful, Beautiful'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'supra' meaning 'above' and 'rith' meaning 'to be', indicating one who is above all and possesses beauty. The name Supreetha carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Telugu, Kannada. Parents who choose Supreetha usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Supreetha represents the divine feminine energy and symbolizes grace, beauty, and strength. It is believed to bring blessings of happiness, prosperity, and good fortune.
data.etymology: Supreetha belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful, Beautiful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Supreetha total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
